verseText: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
meaning: Because Jesus can return at any moment, we must always be ready. And the way to be ready is to trust in him to save us.

recall.question: Jesus called Himself the “Son of Man.” Why does He tell us to be ready for His return?
choices: He will come when we do not expect Him
He has told us the exact day
He will call us before he comes back

meaning.question: How can we be ready for Jesus to return?
choices: Try to figure out the exact day he will come back
Be good enough to earn His love

application.prompt: Jesus promised to come back at a time we don't expect. And there's only one way to be ready for this unexpected day: to trust in Him before He comes back. As you look forward to seeing Him, how could you follow Him in the choices you make today?
